title: Most Frequent Value
statement:
Find the value that appears most often in the list. If several values appear equally often, report the smallest of them.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers.

## Output
Print the value that appears most often (the smallest one when there is a tie).

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
